summary_en: For fiscal year ending August 2026, annual dividend increased to 32.50 yen per share from 31.00 yen, reflecting upward revision of full-year earnings forecast. This marks 15 consecutive years of dividend increases.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Full-Year Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Transaction Co., Ltd. announced an upward revision of its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending August 31, 2026. The annual dividend per share was increased by 1.50 yen to 32.50 yen from the previously announced 31.00 yen. The increase follows an upward revision of the full-year earnings forecast, with net profit attributable to parent company shareholders raised to 4,529 million yen from 4,288 million yen, reflecting strong performance across e-commerce and lifestyle product categories in the first year of the company's five-year medium-term management plan.

The dividend revision is aligned with the company's dividend policy of maintaining a payout ratio of 40% or higher. Compared to the prior fiscal year result of 57.00 yen per share (adjusted for a 2-for-1 stock split implemented on September 1, 2025), the dividend represents an increase of 4.00 yen. This marks the 15th consecutive year of dividend increases since the company's listing.
